summary: Four execFileAsync('git', ...) calls (getGitHead, getGitChangedFiles, getGitExactRenames, getGitNewFiles/getGitDirtyFiles) that omit windowsHide — confirmed via a real windows-latest CI repro (see the #149 flow note in scripts/win-repro/) that this exact option shape DOES flash a visible console window on Windows. getGitHead runs on every debounced keeper cache save and the others run on every keeper-start reconcile, so this is a live, high-frequency instance of issue #149's bug, left unpatched by the initial 7-site fix. Not yet fixed as of this note.
